# @orb-club/modules

Purpose: auth-first, plugin-based SDK for token/session flows, QR auth, media parsing, Grove uploads, and optional backend transport.

Read in this order:
- `README.md`
- `docs/getting-started.md`
- `docs/auth.md`
- `docs/configuration.md`
- `docs/media.md`
- `docs/upload-grove.md`
- `docs/transport-backend.md`
- `docs/errors.md`
- `AGENTS.md`

Capability map:
- root: `createSDK`, core errors, core types
- `@orb-club/modules/auth`: `authPlugin`, token/session helpers, auth errors
- `@orb-club/modules/auth/qr`: `qrAuthPlugin`, QR request helpers, QR errors
- `@orb-club/modules/media`: `mediaPlugin`, media MIME helpers
- `@orb-club/modules/upload/grove`: `groveUploadPlugin`, Grove upload errors
- `@orb-club/modules/transport/backend`: `backendTransportPlugin`, backend transport errors

Runtime map:
- `auth`: browser or server
- `auth/qr`: browser client flow with app-provided QR endpoints
- `media`: browser or server
- `upload/grove`: browser-only
- `transport/backend`: trusted runtime or app proxy

Rules for agents:
- Prefer root + subpath imports; do not invent root re-exports for plugins.
- Do not reintroduce Orb-specific env names, hardcoded URLs, or backend route names.
- Keep the core framework-agnostic.
- Update `README.md`, `llms.txt`, and the relevant docs page whenever the public surface changes.
